## The Columns

| Column | What Goes in It |
|---|---|
| Name | What the color is, such as Logo Red. Optional. |
| Hex | The color: `#C8102E`, `C8102E` or the short `#C12`. A row without a hex code is skipped. |
| Notes | For whoever reads the file. |

## What an Export Adds

Each color's best Sherwin-Williams, Pantone and 3M 3630 match with its match %, and any formula the office has on file.
